abstract.t: This document specifies the did:alter Decentralized Identifier method. A did:alter identifier names a ~handle together with the DNS zone that publishes the handle's signed envelope, and it resolves to a DID document by running the envelope recognition procedure of the companion specification for discovering Model Context Protocol servers through DNS TXT records, then expressing the verified envelope's Ed25519 key as a verification method. The identifier agrees with the handle grammar of the alter URI scheme and with the did:alter form already written by the identity-attributed commits specification. The method introduces no new record, no new cryptographic primitive and no registry of its own: create, update and deactivate are the publication, replacement and revocation of that envelope, and read is its verification. The document also sets out what the method cannot yet do, because the envelope record it reads carries no key history, and revocation cannot presently be observed from DNS alone.
